descriptionMarkdown:
So basically, since Factorio 2.1 is going to remove the old quality casino using the reprocessing asteroids recipe, I started thinking about what could replace it. I knew about the change around two weeks ago, so I wanted to make another method before it gets removed. The idea of this ship is almost the same as the old quality casino, but instead of using asteroid reprocessing, I’m using asteroid crushing, because crushing still allows Quality modules. It also becomes much better when you have asteroid productivity research maxed (300%). I’m not saying this is as good as the old method, because it’s not, and I want to be fair about that. But with max asteroid productivity, the numbers are actually pretty good. Right now it makes around 1.7k legendary iron ore per minute and 300 legendary copper ore per minute (My current asteroid productivity research is 260% and the numbers changed based on the trip directuion). I used advanced metallic asteroid crushing because I wanted copper. If you don’t care about legendary copper and only want iron, you can switch the last row from advanced metallic asteroid crushing to normal asteroid crushing, and that gives around more and more iron. So yeah, it’s not the old broken casino, but it’s a pretty good 2.1 alternative if you want to keep making legendary ore using asteroids.

The main limitation I found with this ship is the asteroid collection. I tested adding more collectors, but it did not really improve the output. From what I noticed, around 51 asteroid collectors seems to be the best number for this design. I also tried going much higher and used 87 asteroid collectors, thinking maybe that would help collect more metallic chunks, but honestly it was worse. It slowed the whole ship down more, and the extra collectors did not fix the problem. So I don’t think just adding more collectors is the answer here. The bottleneck is that the ship is not collecting enough metallic asteroid chunks, and after a certain point, adding more collectors just makes the ship heavier/slower without giving better results.

For the versions, I recommend using V2.2. That is the version I would say is the best one to use normally. If you are limited on resources or you don’t have enough legendary crushers, then use V2 instead. I included V1, V1.1, and V1.2 mostly to show the story of how the design evolved, not because I recommend using them. They do work, but they are bigger and slower, so they are more like early test versions. Also, one thing I want to clarify is that the number of crushers is not resource-efficient. The lanes are ordered by quality: the first four lanes are common, then one uncommon lane, one rare lane, one epic lane, and the last lane is legendary. If you are really limited, you can modify the crusher count instead of fully building every lane. Keep the first two common lanes complete, then make the next two common lanes use only four crushers each. After that, the uncommon and rare lanes can use only two crushers each, and then the epic and legendary lanes can use only one crusher each.

Small note: this ship uses a lane-switching mod. I don’t remember the exact name of the mod, but basically it lets you choose if inserters put items on the near lane or the far lane. The ship was built using that, so if you don’t have the mod right now, you might have some problems with the belts/inserters. But in Factorio 2.1 this should become a vanilla feature, so once 2.1 is out, the ship should work normally without needing the mod. Also, the ship currently uses a fusion reactor as the main power source. I think you could remove it and replace it with legendary solar panels and legendary accumulators, but I did not test that, so I’m not 100% sure. And one more thing: there is one Tesla turret on the ship, but it’s only there for decoration. You don’t need it, and you can remove it if you want the ship to be more practical.
title: Quality Casino (For 2.1)
